days.name: Log / Upper — quality over volume
days.note: 102.5 kg top work achieved on 28 Sep. Keep competition specificity, then use a broad upper-body spread instead of more log variations.

exercises.name: Competition Log C&P
exercises.note: Achieved. Full clean, tall rack, short dip, legs initiate, arms finish. After the 5-item warm-up, ramp the empty 80 kg log with: 80 × 2, 90 × 1, 97.5 × 1. These are preparation reps, not extra work sets.

exercises.name: Incline Barbell Press
exercises.note: Build pressing strength without another log variation.

exercises.name: Chest-Supported Row
exercises.note: Upper-back work with no lower-back fatigue.

exercises.name: Cable Pullover
exercises.note: Low-fatigue lat work for rack position and deadlift control.

exercises.name: Cable / DB Triceps Extension
exercises.note: Leave reps in reserve.

exercises.name: Rear Delt / Face Pull
exercises.note: Easy shoulder-health work.

warmup.name: Raise temperature
warmup.note: Easy pace. Finish warm, not tired.

warmup.name: Banded lat stretch
warmup.note: Gentle hold; breathe into the upper back.

warmup.name: Bench T-spine extension
warmup.note: Open the upper back without flaring the ribs.

warmup.name: Band pass-through + face pull
warmup.note: Smooth range; prime the shoulders and upper back.

warmup.name: Bodyweight jump primer
warmup.note: Short dip, violent extension; rehearse leg drive without fatigue.

cardio.name: Optional easy cooldown
cardio.note: Skip if you still feel nauseous or unusually fatigued.

days.name: Deadlift / Back
days.note: One main deadlift exposure, then back, hamstrings and arms. No second heavy hinge variation.

exercises.name: Competition Deadlift
exercises.note: If this is >RPE 8, hold next week rather than forcing progression. After the 5-item warm-up, ramp with: 70 × 5, 120 × 3, 160 × 2, 195 × 1, 215 × 1. Keep every warm-up rep crisp and stop adding volume once ready.

exercises.name: Deadlift Back-off
exercises.note: Fast, technically identical reps.

exercises.name: Chest-Supported / Cable Row
exercises.note: Keep the torso supported.

exercises.name: Cable Pullover
exercises.note: Low-fatigue lat work.

exercises.name: Seated / Lying Leg Curl
exercises.note: Hamstrings without more spinal loading.

exercises.name: Lat Pulldown
exercises.note: Controlled full range.

exercises.name: Hammer Curl
exercises.note: Elbow-flexor and grip support.

warmup.name: Raise temperature
warmup.prescription: 5 min incline walk or easy bike

warmup.name: Hamstring floss
warmup.note: Move through range rather than holding a deep stretch.

cardio.name: Optional recovery walk
cardio.note: Only if it helps you downshift.

days.name: Legs
days.note: A complete leg session: squat pattern, machine quad work, hamstrings, unilateral work, calves and bracing.

exercises.name: Paused Front Squat
exercises.note: 1–2 second pause; upright torso.

exercises.name: Hack Squat / Leg Press
exercises.note: Quad work without turning the day into another max-effort squat session.

exercises.name: Standing Calf Raise
exercises.note: Useful ankle strength for carries and leg drive.

exercises.name: Weighted Core / Cable Crunch
exercises.note: Brace hard without creating lower-back fatigue.

warmup.name: Goblet squat pry
warmup.note: Breathe into the bottom position, then stand smoothly.

days.name: Saturday Strongman — Full Body
days.note: A varied strongman session: brief log skill, light deadlift technique, moving event, loading event, sled and bracing. Nothing maximal.

exercises.name: Competition Log — Leg-Drive Singles
exercises.note: Full clean each rep. Tall rack → brace → short vertical dip → legs first → arms finish.

exercises.name: Paused Deadlift
exercises.note: Pause just off the floor; technical support only.

exercises.name: Farmers / Frame Carry
exercises.note: Fast pick, tall posture, controlled speed.

exercises.name: Sandbag Carry / Load
exercises.note: Use the setup available; no maximal bag work.

exercises.name: Sled Push / Backward Drag
exercises.note: Steady work, not a conditioning test.

exercises.name: Pallof Press / Dead Bug
exercises.note: Finish with controlled bracing work.

warmup.name: Adductor rock-back + hip-flexor stretch
warmup.note: Open the hips for carries, pulls and loading.

warmup.name: Very light sled drag / brisk walk

cardio.name: No extra cardio required
cardio.note: The event work is enough conditioning today.
